recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast studio portrait of a female figure in a sheer black garment, set against a neutral, desaturated background with wide-tracked serif typography framing the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast lighting defining muscle and fabric texture
Typography balanced between top and bottom margins
coreInvariants: Sheer, draped black fabric with high sheen
Wide letter spacing (tracking) in all-caps text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full torso and head centered, occupying 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and direct gaze, framed by dark bangs.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down the subject's face and torso, ending at the bottom title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniformly lit, flat background surrounding the subject to emphasize silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows and sheer fabric
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for typography and highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a wide value range from deep blacks to bright white highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scale and tracking for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Rectangular advisory badge in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast for a fashion-forward look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-fashion studio portrait of a woman with long hair and bangs, wearing a sheer black silk blouse, posed with one arm raised. Use high-contrast lighting to emphasize the texture of the fabric and skin. The entire image should be in a desaturated sepia or taupe monochrome tone.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply all-caps serif text at the top and bottom margins with extremely wide tracking. Use white color for the text. Add a small rectangular content advisory badge in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to span the width of the subject?
Is the color palette strictly desaturated?
Are the serifs sharp and classical?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean, sharp edges on typography
Ensure the sheer fabric texture is rendered with realistic highlights
Verify the centered balance of the composition
Confirm the sepia tone is consistent across the entire image
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochromatic studio portrait with wide-tracked Roman serif typography for a timeless, high-fashion editorial look.
